placements.why: Establishes a new organizational category for field management practices that optimize agricultural timing, material inputs, and field labor.
placements.title: Calibrating seasonal orchard interventions and materials to biological cycles and labor efficiency
placements.frame: How should orchard operational workflows balance biological timing with labor demands across field cycles?

placements.title: Shifting Grafting to February Dormancy and Adopting Biodegradable Tape
placements.frame: How should grafting timing and binding materials be calibrated to rootstock dormancy, scion storage, and post-graft field maintenance?
placements.why: Enacts an operational schedule shift to February based on rootstock dormancy and empirical take rates, while replacing tape with biodegradable material to eliminate May field labor.
